usage.callShape: POST https://mailcheck.hugen.tokyo/mailcheck/validate with JSON body {"email":"<address>"} (x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.01)
usage.outputShape: body.status, body.score, body.syntax_valid, body.domain, body.mx_found, body.mx_records[], body.is_disposable, body.is_free, body.is_role_based, body.did_you_mean, body.checks_performed[]
quirks: POST with a JSON body {"email":"..."}; the response is synchronous JSON (no job id / polling).
Gate deliverability on body.status + body.score; body.is_disposable / body.is_role_based / body.mx_found give the detail.
body.did_you_mean is non-null when a likely typo is detected (e.g. gmial.com -> gmail.com).
usage.guide: Validate an email address by POSTing JSON {"email":"<address>"} to https://mailcheck.hugen.tokyo/mailcheck/validate. Pay via x402 (USDC on Base, ~$0.01 per call, no API key). The 200 JSON response is synchronous and self-contained: read body.status and body.score for the headline verdict, and the boolean flags (syntax_valid, mx_found, is_disposable, is_free, is_role_based) plus body.did_you_mean for details. No auth or polling needed. (This is the primary active backend; the netintel and x402node backends are alternates.)
